title: Parasitic Co-Denoising: Unlocking 3D Human Motion Generation in a Frozen Video Diffusion Model
title_zh: 寄生式协同去噪：在冻结的视频扩散模型中实现 3D 人类动作生成

paragraphs.en: Despite never being supervised on explicit 3D motion, large-scale text-to-video diffusion models synthesize realistic human motion in their generated videos. We ask whether this implicit knowledge can be turned into explicit 3D motion generation, without training a separate motion model. Probing a frozen Wan2.1 reveals that a recoverable motion signal is present in its intermediate states across the entire denoising schedule, not confined to the clean output. Motivated by this, we introduce parasitic co-denoising, a paradigm in which motion is decoded from the host model along its denoising schedule rather than produced by an independent generator. We instantiate it as the Parasitic Motion Decoder (PMD), an efficient flow-matching decoder that shares the host’s noise schedule and reads its intermediate features through a σ \sigma -adaptive multi-layer fusion, leaving the host unmodified. Drawing its coverage from the host rather than from motion data, PMD leads dedicated motion generators on text-motion alignment at a small fraction of their trainable parameters, while producing paired video and motion in a single pass that motion-only baselines cannot match.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管从未接受过对显式三维运动的监督，大规模文本到视频扩散模型仍能在生成的视频中合成逼真的人类运动。 我们提出一个问题：这种隐式知识是否可以转化为显式的三维运动生成能力，而无需训练一个独立的运动模型。 对冻结的 Wan2.1 模型进行探测发现，在整个去噪流程中，其中间状态都包含可恢复的运动信号，而不仅仅局限于最终干净的输出。 基于这一发现，我们提出了寄生协同去噪方法：一种让运动信号沿着主模型的去噪流程被解码出来，而非由独立生成器产生的范式。 我们将该方法具体化为寄生运动解码器（PMD）——一个高效的流匹配解码器，它与主模型共享噪声调度表，并通过 σ-自适应多层融合读取其中间特征，同时无需对主模型进行任何修改。 PMD 的覆盖范围源自主模型而非运动数据，因此它仅以极小比例的训练参数即可引导专用运动生成器实现文本与运动的对齐，同时能以单次处理同步生成视频和运动信号，这是纯运动基线模型无法实现的。

paragraphs.en: Human motion generation ( Plappert et al. 2016 ; Yu et al. 2026 ) drives applications such as animation ( Mourot et al. 2022 ) , virtual reality ( Burdea and Coiffet 2003 ) , and embodied AI ( Duan et al. 2022 ) . Recent text-to-motion models advance rapidly ( Weng et al. 2026 ; Zeng et al. 2025 ) , yet the scarcity of motion-capture data leaves them unable to cover the long tail of human behavior. Large-scale video diffusion models ( Blattmann et al. 2023 ) , by contrast, train on internet-scale data and render diverse humans in natural, varied motion. Such motion, learned without any explicit 3D supervision, shows that these models already internalize how humans move. This paper asks whether this implicit knowledge can become explicit 3D motion generation, without training a separate motion model.

paragraphs.en: Recent efforts leverage video models for 3D motion generation ( Yang et al. 2025 ; Lin et al. 2025 ) , jointly training a separate motion branch under the guidance of video features. For this branch to inherit the video model’s generalization, it must be trained on 3D motion at a comparable scale, which drives these methods to contribute large paired video-motion datasets. This effort rebuilds in a separate pipeline a capacity the video model may already possess, and incurs the additional cost of training and storing a second generative model. This suggests a more direct alternative: if motion is already encoded in the video model’s generative process, can it be decoded from it, rather than relearned in a separate model?
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究利用视频模型进行三维运动生成（Yang 等人，2025；Lin 等人，2025），在视频特征的指导下联合训练一个独立的运动分支。 为了使该分支能够继承视频模型的泛化能力，它必须在相当规模的三维运动数据上进行训练，这也促使这些方法贡献了大规模的视频-运动配对数据集。 这种尝试在一个独立的流程中重建了视频模型可能已经具备的能力，并带来了训练和存储第二个生成模型所带来的额外成本。 这表明存在一种更直接的替代方案：如果运动信息已经被编码在视频模型的生成过程中，那么是否可以直接从中解码出来，而不是在另一个独立模型中重新学习？

paragraphs.en: To answer this, we first ask where motion should be decoded from. Reading from the model’s clean output trivially recovers motion but reduces the problem to pose estimation ( Zhou et al. 2023 ) , ignoring the generative process that produced it. The question we pursue is whether motion is already present in the intermediate denoising states themselves. At each noise level σ \sigma , we probe a frozen Wan2.1 video model ( Wan et al. 2025 ) for the alignment between its intermediate state and the corresponding state of HY-Motion ( Team 2025 ) , a state-of-the-art open-source text-to-motion flow-matching model (Figure 1 ). The two are remarkably aligned. Across the entire schedule, the video model’s intermediate states retain 54–81% of the dedicated model’s motion-discriminative accuracy, holding 81% even at σ = 0.9 \sigma=0.9 , where the input is nearly pure noise. Motion information inside the video model is therefore not localized at its clean endpoint. It is present throughout the denoising trajectory, exposing a signal that a motion generator can ride on rather than relearn.
paragraphs.zh: 要回答这个问题，我们首先需要明确运动信息应该从何处解码。 直接从模型的干净输出中读取数据虽然能轻松恢复运动，但会将问题简化为姿态估计（Zhou et al. 2023），同时忽略了生成该运动的生成过程。 我们所探讨的问题是：运动信息是否已经存在于中间的去噪状态本身之中。 在每个噪声水平 σ \sigma 处，我们使用一个冻结的 Wan2.1 视频模型（Wan et al. 2025），探究其中间状态与 HY-Motion（Team 2025）相应状态之间的对齐程度；HY-Motion 是一种先进的开源文本到运动流匹配模型（图 1）。 两者表现出惊人的高度对齐。 在整个噪声调度过程中，视频模型的中间状态保留了专用模型 54%–81% 的运动判别准确性，即使在 σ = 0.9 \sigma=0.9（此时输入几乎完全是噪声）的情况下，仍能保留 81% 的准确性。 因此，视频模型内部的运动信息并非仅存在于其干净的最终输出中。 这些信息贯穿整个去噪过程，揭示了一种信号：运动生成器可以直接利用它，而无需重新学习。

paragraphs.en: The signal exposed above suggests a separate motion generator is unnecessary, and motion can instead be decoded from the video model along its denoising schedule, produced together with the video. We call this strategy parasitic co-denoising . By reusing the host’s features at each step, the motion decoder attains the video model’s broad coverage at little extra cost. This requires more than reading off features at a single point. Such a readout accesses only one slice of the host’s trajectory and discards the rest, contradicting the very finding that motion is present at every noise level. To exploit that presence, the motion generator must itself unfold along the same trajectory, sharing the host’s noise schedule and advancing one step at a time alongside it. The motion decoder therefore advances on the same schedule as the host and conditions each step on the host’s matched- σ \sigma features, so that video generation and motion decoding proceed in step.
paragraphs.zh: 上述信号表明，无需使用独立的运动生成器；相反，运动可以从视频模型中沿着与其一同生成的去噪时间表进行解码。 我们将这一策略称为寄生式协同去噪。 通过在每一步复用宿主模型的特征，运动解码器能以极小的额外成本获得视频模型的广泛覆盖能力。 这需要的不仅仅是从单个点读取特征。 这种读取方式仅能获取宿主轨迹的一个片段，而丢弃其余部分，这与“运动存在于每个噪声水平”这一发现本身相矛盾。 为了利用这种存在性，运动生成器自身必须沿着相同的轨迹展开，共享宿主的噪声时间表，并与其同步逐步推进。 因此，运动解码器与宿主模型遵循相同的时间表推进，并在每一步以宿主模型匹配σ的特征为条件，从而实现视频生成与运动解码的同步进行。

paragraphs.en: We realize this design as the Parasitic Motion Decoder (PMD), a parameter-efficient decoder attached to a frozen Wan2.1 video DiT. PMD is itself a flow-matching decoder sharing the host’s noise schedule. At each step, it reads intermediate features from the video DiT, fuses them through a σ \sigma -adaptive mechanism that learns which layers to attend to at each noise level, and updates its own motion latents via a learned velocity field. The video model is never modified. On open-world motion synthesis, PMD leads dedicated motion generators trained on substantially larger motion corpora, and inherits the broad semantic coverage of the underlying video model, generalizing to complex actions that lie outside the reach of motion-specific datasets.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将这一设计实现为寄生运动解码器（PMD），这是一种附加在冻结的 Wan2.1 视频 DiT 上的参数高效解码器。 PMD 本身是一种流匹配解码器，与宿主模型共享噪声调度表。 在每个步骤中，它从视频 DiT 读取中间特征，通过一个 σ \sigma -自适应机制对这些特征进行融合——该机制能够学习在每个噪声层级上应关注哪些层——并通过一个已学习的速度场更新其自身的运动潜在变量。 视频模型本身从未被修改。 在开放世界的运动合成任务中，PMD 的表现优于那些在规模大得多的运动语料库上训练的专业运动生成器，并且继承了底层视频模型的广泛语义覆盖能力，能够泛化到运动专用数据集无法涵盖的复杂动作。

paragraphs.en: The main contributions are summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 主要贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We empirically show that a frozen text-to-video diffusion model already carries a recoverable 3D human motion signal, decodable from its intermediate states throughout the entire denoising schedule.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过实证表明，一个冻结的文本到视频扩散模型已经包含可恢复的三维人体运动信号，该信号可以在整个去噪流程的中间状态中被解码出来。

paragraphs.en: We introduce parasitic co-denoising , a paradigm in which a secondary modality is decoded from a host model along its own denoising schedule rather than produced by an independent generator, applicable to hosts whose denoising process exposes a usable signal for that modality.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种寄生式协同去噪方法：在这种范式下，一个次要模态会从主模型中按照其自身的去噪时间表进行解码，而不是由独立的生成器产生；该方法适用于那些去噪过程能为该模态提供可用信号的主模型。

paragraphs.en: PMD leads dedicated motion generators on text-motion alignment while producing paired video and motion in a single pass, at a small fraction of trainable parameters.
paragraphs.zh: PMD引导专用的运动生成器进行文本与运动的对齐，同时以单次处理生成配对的视频和运动，且仅使用极小比例的训练参数。

paragraphs.en: Methods for text-conditioned 3D human motion generation can be broadly grouped by representation. Early approaches encode motion in a variational latent ( Petrovich et al. 2022 ; Guo et al. 2022b ) . Diffusion-based methods including MDM ( Tevet et al. 2022 ) and MotionDiffuse ( Zhang et al. 2024 ) denoise raw kinematic sequences, with later work adding physical plausibility ( Yuan et al. 2023 ) and fine-grained control ( Xie et al. 2024 ) . Token-based methods such as T2M-GPT ( Zhang et al. 2023a ) and MoMask ( Guo et al. 2024 ) learn discrete motion tokens with autoregressive or masked transformers, a recipe later scaled with language-model backbones ( Jiang et al. 2023 ) . FineMoGen ( Zhang et al. 2023b ) introduces fine-grained spatio-temporal control, MotionLCM ( Dai et al. 2024 ) accelerates inference via consistency distillation, and MotionCraft ( Bian et al. 2025 ) scales motion training data.
paragraphs.zh: 文本条件化三维人类动作生成的方法可大致按表示形式进行归类。 早期的方法将动作编码在变分潜在空间中（Petrovich 等人，2022；Guo 等人，2022b）。 基于扩散的方法，包括 MDM（Tevet 等人，2022）和 MotionDiffuse（Zhang 等人，2024），通过去除原始运动学序列的噪声来实现生成，后续研究则进一步加入了物理合理性（Yuan 等人，2023）和精细控制（Xie 等人，2024）。 基于词元的方法，如 T2M-GPT（Zhang 等人，2023a）和 MoMask（Guo 等人，2024），利用自回归或掩码变换器学习离散的动作词元，这一方法后来通过语言模型主干架构得到了扩展（Jiang 等人，2023）。 FineMoGen（Zhang 等人，2023b）引入了精细的空间时间控制，MotionLCM（Dai 等人，2024）通过一致性蒸馏加速了推理过程，而 MotionCraft（Bian 等人，2025）则扩展了动作训练数据。

paragraphs.en: A growing line of work reuses features or weights of large-scale pretrained generative models for downstream tasks ( Yang et al. 2024 ; Kong et al. 2024 ) . Diffusion features have been shown to support semantic segmentation ( Baranchuk et al. 2021 ) , semantic correspondence ( Tang et al. 2023 ) , monocular depth ( Ke et al. 2024 ) , self-supervised representation learning ( Xiang et al. 2023 ) , and self-conditioning ( Feng et al. 2024 ) . In the motion domain, ViMoGen ( Lin et al. 2025 ) uses video features as auxiliary supervision when training a 1.2 1.2 B text-to-motion DiT (with a distilled 600 600 M variant for video-free inference); EchoMotion ( Yang et al. 2025 ) jointly fine-tunes video and motion branches of a dual-modality DiT. MoAlign ( Bhowmik et al. 2025 ) aligns video diffusion features with motion-aware subspaces. Most existing approaches either read out features at the clean endpoint of the host’s generation or distill its weights into a separate model. PMD participates in the denoising process itself, decoding motion from intermediate states at every σ \sigma .

paragraphs.en: Motivated by our finding that large-scale video diffusion models implicitly carry a recoverable human motion signal along their denoising trajectories, we tackle text-to-motion generation by attaching a parasitic decoder to a frozen video model. Wan2.1, like other modern video diffusion models, operates as a latent diffusion model ( Rombach et al. 2022 ) : a VAE ( Kingma and Welling 2013 ) first encodes the video into a compact latent, and a DiT denoises this latent through a flow-matching schedule indexed by an interpolation coefficient σ ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \sigma\in[0,1] . Given a text prompt c c , the DiT advances the video latent from σ = 1 \sigma=1 (Gaussian noise) to σ = 0 \sigma=0 (clean video latent), which the VAE then decodes into a video 𝐯 \mathbf{v} . Our decoder runs in the same latent paradigm: it advances a motion latent in lockstep with Wan2.1 along the identical schedule, producing a 3D human motion 𝐦 \mathbf{m} alongside the video. We instantiate such a decoder in two stages (Figure 2 ). Stage 1 aligns a motion latent space with video latent space, giving the two streams a shared geometry. Stage 2 trains the parasitic motion decoder (PMD), a flow-matching decoder that shares Wan2.1’s schedule and, at each step, reads features from selected DiT layers, fuses them through a σ \sigma -adaptive mechanism, and predicts a motion velocity.
paragraphs.zh: 受我们发现的启发——大规模视频扩散模型在其去噪轨迹中隐式地携带了可恢复的人类运动信号，我们通过将一个寄生解码器附加到一个冻结的视频模型上，来解决文本到运动的生成问题。 Wan2.1 与其他现代视频扩散模型一样，作为一个潜在扩散模型（Rombach et al. 2022）运行：首先，一个 VAE（Kingma and Welling 2013）将视频编码为紧凑的潜在表示；然后，一个 DiT 通过以插值系数 σ ∈ [0,1] 为索引的流程匹配方案对该潜在表示进行去噪。 给定文本提示 c，DiT 会将视频潜在表示从 σ = 1（高斯噪声）推进到 σ = 0（干净的视频潜在表示），随后 VAE 将其解码为视频 𝐯。 我们的解码器采用相同的潜在范式运行：它与 Wan2.1 同步，沿着完全相同的方案推进运动潜在表示，从而在生成视频的同时产出三维人类运动 𝐦。 我们将这种解码器具体实现为两个阶段（图 2）。 第一阶段将运动潜在空间与视频潜在空间对齐，使两个流共享相同的几何结构。 第二阶段训练寄生运动解码器（PMD），这是一个流程匹配解码器，它与 Wan2.1 共享相同的方案，并在每一步从选定的 DiT 层读取特征，通过一个 σ-自适应机制融合这些特征，并预测运动速度。

paragraphs.en: For the parasitic decoder to inherit the video model’s generative trajectory, the motion representation must live in a space compatible with the video latent. paragraphs.en: With motion and video sharing the latent space ℝ T × d z \mathbb{R}^{T\times d_{z}} from Stage 1, we now build the parasitic motion decoder (PMD) that denoises a motion latent in lockstep with the video DiT (Figure 2 b). Tying the two processes to a single schedule lets motion and video align at every σ \sigma , so that features extracted from the host’s denoising process can be consumed by motion denoising at the matched σ \sigma .

paragraphs.en: This shared formulation means that, for any σ \sigma , the host’s intermediate state 𝐱 ′ σ v \mathbf{x^{\prime}}^{v}_{\sigma} and the motion state 𝐱 σ m \mathbf{x}^{m}_{\sigma} occupy the same index of their respective trajectories. The two noise draws ϵ v \boldsymbol{\epsilon}^{v} and ϵ m \boldsymbol{\epsilon}^{m} remain independent, so the coupling comes from the shared schedule and the feature conditioning rather than from a shared noise realization. PMD predicts 𝐯 m ∗ σ \mathbf{v}^{m*}_{\sigma} at every σ \sigma , conditioned on the text prompt c c and intermediate features hooked from the host DiT at the matched σ \sigma . Motion is thus produced not by an independent flow but by a decoder that shares the host’s schedule and reads its features on the aligned latent space.

paragraphs.en: PMD is a lightweight flow-matching decoder built around a single guiding principle: rather than learn a generative trajectory from scratch, it follows the host’s schedule and decodes the motion signal the host exposes at each step into an explicit motion. To do so, PMD must read this signal from within the host’s process. We therefore hook a set of intermediate features { 𝐟 ℓ } ℓ = 1 L \{\mathbf{f}_{\ell}\}_{\ell=1}^{L} from L L selected DiT layers at the matched σ \sigma , exposing the partially denoised representations on which the host’s velocity prediction is built. These features are then fused into a single σ \sigma -dependent video signal 𝐤𝐯 vid \mathbf{kv}_{\text{vid}} that PMD can directly attend to.
paragraphs.zh: PMD 是一种轻量级的流匹配解码器，其构建基于一个核心原则：与其从头学习生成轨迹，不如遵循主程序的调度，并将主程序在每个步骤中暴露的运动信号解码为显式的运动。 为此，PMD 必须从主程序进程内部读取该信号。 因此，我们从 L 个选定的 DiT 层中钩接一组中间特征 { 𝐟 ℓ } ℓ = 1 L \{\mathbf{f}_{\ell}\}_{\ell=1}^{L}，在匹配的 σ \sigma 处获取这些特征，从而暴露出主程序的速度预测所依赖的部分去噪表示。 随后，这些特征被融合为一个单一的、依赖于 σ \sigma 的视频信号 𝐤𝐯 vid \mathbf{kv}_{\text{vid}}，PMD 可以直接对此进行注意力处理。

Second, a small per-layer adapter corrects the residual mismatch of each layer. The host’s head expects the final-layer distribution, and intermediate layers deviate from it. Finally, the projection P v P_{v} from Stage 1 takes the adapted features into the shared motion-video latent space. P v P_{v} is reused as is, with no further training. paragraphs.en: We test whether a frozen video diffusion model carries motion along its denoising trajectory through a cross-modal alignment study. Each HumanML3D ( Guo et al. 2022a ) motion is rendered in Unreal Engine 5 ( Karis and Games 2013 ) from 10 10 viewpoints with randomized identity, clothing, and background, leaving paired videos of the same motion with no shared appearance cues. At each σ \sigma , we extract velocity-field features from the host on a paired video and from HY-Motion ( Team 2025 ) , a SOTA text-to-motion model, on the corresponding motion. HY-Motion takes only motion as input, so alignment with its states reflects motion content, not visual similarity. We measure it by top- 1 1 retrieval against 400 400 held-out candidates, averaged over the ten viewpoints. Figure 1 shows a recoverable motion signal across the entire schedule, supporting parasitic co-denoising. We next turn this signal into competitive generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过一种跨模态对齐研究，检验一个冻结的视频扩散模型是否会在其去噪轨迹中携带运动信息。 每个 HumanML3D（Guo et al. 2022a）的运动都在 Unreal Engine 5（Karis and Games 2013）中，从 10 个视角进行渲染，并随机设置身份、服装和背景，从而得到同一运动但外观特征完全不共享的成对视频。 在每个 σ \sigma 处，我们从主模型在成对视频上提取速度场特征，并从 HY-Motion（Team 2025）——一个 SOTA 文本到运动模型——在对应运动上的输出中提取速度场特征。 HY-Motion 仅以运动作为输入，因此与其状态的对齐反映的是运动内容，而非视觉相似性。 我们通过将结果与 400 个预留候选项进行 top-1 检索来衡量这一指标，并对十个视角取平均值。 图 1 展示了在整个时间规划中可恢复的运动信号，这支持了寄生式协同去噪的可能性。 接下来，我们将这种信号转化为具有竞争力的生成能力。

Under the data-scarce Protocol A, PMD outperforms every dedicated generator by a clear margin: when motion data is limited, reading the host’s features along the schedule already supplies the semantic coverage that a from-scratch generator lacks. Under the large-scale Protocol B, PMD stays ahead of the far larger ViMoGen and the concurrent scene-conditioned MotionVLA, at a small fraction of their trainable parameters. The advantage thus holds from scarce to abundant data, tracking the host’s representational depth rather than the size of any dedicated motion model.

paragraphs.en: The clearest test of the paradigm is to remove the host signal: PMD collapses to a text-only generator of the same size (Table 3 ) and both semantic metrics fall sharply. The capability is the host’s, not the decoder’s. The other two components make it reachable. Removing the text condition keeps coarse semantics from the host but loses fine prompt control, and removing Stage 1 alignment is most damaging, leaving host features with no usable motion space and collapsing training.
paragraphs.zh: 检验这一范式的最清晰方法就是移除宿主信号：PMD 会退化为一个尺寸相同、仅生成文本的模型（表 3），且两种语义指标都会急剧下降。 这种能力属于宿主，而非解码器。 另外两个组件使其变得可行。 移除文本条件会阻止宿主获取粗粒度语义，但会失去对提示的精细控制；而移除第 1 阶段的对齐则破坏性最强，导致宿主的特征没有可用的运动空间，训练也随之崩溃。

paragraphs.en: We next examine how the host signal should be read. A single final-layer hook lags the full model by a wide margin, so the signal is not concentrated at the clean output but spread across the host’s depth. A static uniform mixture narrows the gap yet still trails, since a fixed blend cannot track how layer relevance shifts along the schedule. Figure 4 exposes that shift: the mid-late layer L29 dominates throughout, while early- and late-layer contributions swap as denoising proceeds. Even hooking L29 alone, the strongest layer, falls short of the fusion, and it in turn beats a final-layer hook, so both which layer and how many matter. The motion signal lives in the shifting interplay across layers, and only σ \sigma -adaptive fusion tracks it.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们将研究如何读取主机信号。 仅使用最后一层的智能体与完整模型存在巨大差距，因此信号并未集中在纯净输出上，而是分布在整个主机的深度中。 静态均匀混合虽然缩小了差距，但仍处于落后状态，因为固定混合无法追踪各层相关性随时间流程的变化。 图 4 揭示了这种变化：中间至后期的 L29 层始终占据主导地位，而早期和晚期层的贡献则随着降噪过程发生交替。 即使仅连接最强的 L29 层智能体，其表现仍不及融合方案；而融合方案又优于仅使用最后一层智能体的方式，因此具体使用哪一层以及使用多少层都至关重要。 运动信号存在于各层之间动态变化的相互作用中，而只有 σ \sigma -自适应融合能够追踪这种变化。

paragraphs.en: Reading motion from the host invites a natural worry: that PMD merely transcribes each video into one fixed pose sequence, reducing generation to deterministic readout. Figure 6 rules this out. For each host video, eight noise seeds yield distinct yet host-consistent motions, tightly clustered per video but clearly spread within each cluster (within-video pairwise MPJPE 40 ± 12 40\pm 12 mm across 50 50 videos). The host shapes the motion without fixing it, and PMD generates from its own noise rather than reading a predetermined answer off the host.
paragraphs.zh: 从宿主中读取运动模式会引发一个自然的担忧：PMD 可能只是将每个视频转录为单一固定的姿态序列，从而将生成过程简化为确定性的读取操作。图 6 排除了这种可能性。 对于每个宿主视频，八个噪声种子会产生不同但保持一致的运动模式；这些模式在单个视频内部紧密聚集，但在每个簇内又明显分散（50 个视频中，视频内的成对 MPJPE 为 40 ± 12 mm）。 宿主塑造了运动模式，但并未将其固定下来；PMD 是基于自身的噪声进行生成，而不是从宿主中读取一个预定的答案。

paragraphs.en: We presented parasitic co-denoising, a paradigm for generating 3 3 D human motion by decoding it from a frozen video diffusion model along its denoising schedule rather than training an independent motion generator. Our instantiation, the Parasitic Motion Decoder, attaches a flow-matching decoder to a frozen video host through σ \sigma -adaptive multi-layer fusion. At a small fraction of the trainable parameters of dedicated motion generators, it leads them on text-motion alignment. We hope this paradigm extends to other modalities whose generation is implicit in larger generative processes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了寄生式联合去噪（parasitic co-denoising）这一范式，它通过沿着冻结视频扩散模型的去噪流程对冻结模型进行解码来生成三维人类运动，而非训练一个独立的运动生成器。 我们的具体实现——寄生式运动解码器（Parasitic Motion Decoder），通过 σ-自适应多层融合将流匹配解码器附加到冻结的视频宿主模型上。 其可训练参数仅占专用运动生成器的一小部分，却能引导后者实现文本与运动的对齐。 我们希望这一范式能够推广到其他模态，这些模态的生成过程隐含在更庞大的生成流程中。
